rv.q: The ease, command, and power of his renditions is awesome, even if this is not your favorite music.
The Piano and Me is a thrilling story of the music he loves and his biographical adventures on the way to his incredible career in theater and music.
What is indisputable is Felder’s unique gift.
When Felder plays, the world stops to listen.
The result is an intimate and deeply affecting autobiographical portrait that reveals how music shaped not only an extraordinary career but also an extraordinary life.

cn.t: Critics praise Felder's virtuosic piano playing and compelling storytelling, finding his autobiographical show both musically transcendent and emotionally resonant across his global journey.
